title: Junior Front-End Developer (Accessibility Focus)
audioSummary: Gebeya is hiring a Junior Front-End Developer with passion for web accessibility. Requirements include HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WCAG awareness. Accommodation provided for candidates with disabilities.
audioSummaryAm: ገበያ ኢንክ የድር ተደራሽነት ፍላጎት ያለው ጀማሪ የፊት-ለፊት ሶፍትዌር አበልጻጊ እየቀጠረ ነው። መስፈርቶች ኤችቲኤምኤል፣ ሲኤስኤስ፣ ጃቫስክሪፕት እና የተደራሽነት ግንዛቤን ያካትታሉ። ለአካል ጉዳተኛ አመልካቾች ድጋፍ ይሰጣል።
description: We are seeking a junior frontend developer dedicated to building inclusive web experiences. The candidate will work on accessible user interfaces, keyboard navigation, and screen reader compatibility.
requirements: Basic understanding of semantic HTML5 and modern CSS
Familiarity with WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility guidelines
Eagerness to learn screen reader testing (NVDA, TalkBack)
accommodations: Sign language interpreter provided for technical interviews; flexible remote work days; screen reader licensed tools provided.

title: Data Annotation Specialist (Amharic & English)
audioSummary: iCog Labs is looking for an Amharic Data Annotation Specialist. Remote position evaluating Amharic speech and text. Screen reader users warmly welcome.
audioSummaryAm: አይኮግ ላብስ የአማርኛ መረጃ ማብራሪያ ባለሙያ ይፈልጋል። የአማርኛ ንግግር እና ጽሑፍን የሚገመግም የርቀት ስራ ነው። የስክሪን አንባቢ ተጠቃሚዎች በአክብሮት ይጋበዛሉ።
description: Evaluate and annotate transcribed Amharic audio recordings for local language speech models.
requirements: Fluent in spoken and written Amharic
Strong attention to detail in text transcription
accommodations: Fully remote; screen-reader accessible web portal; flexible working hours.
